field_key.sv: service time, years.days, as a STRING
field_key.svy: the season that service-time string is as of, or null
field_key.c: arbitration class at the first remaining ladder season: 0 pre-arb, 1..4 arbitration year
field_key.e: flag bits: 1 step not from published service time, 2 step from the debut heuristic, 4 no salary on file, 8 past the CBA expiry, 16 2020 prorated
field_key.l: ladder, one tuple per remaining season: [season, proj_usd, lo_usd, hi_usd, token]
field_key.tot: sum of the ladder, usd: projected arbitration rungs plus PRE-ARB rungs at the league minimum
field_key.w: projected WAR (eWAR basis) per remaining season, aligned to l

rules.note: Projected seasons from 2027 assume the 2022 CBA arbitration structure survives unchanged. Not estimated from data; no interval covers it.
